events.title: NVIDIA releases Kumo Tabular for zero-training table prediction
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 发布免训练表格预测模型 Kumo Tabular
events.summary: NVIDIA released Kumo Tabular, an open-weight tabular foundation model that predicts classification or regression targets from labeled rows in one forward pass without task-specific training or feature engineering. Three models span 28M to 215M parameters and were pretrained entirely on synthetic tables. NVIDIA reports first-place aggregate results on TabArena, BeyondArena, TALENT and ScoringBench. The weights are ungated under OpenMDW-1.1 and inference code is Apache-2.0, but the training recipe and synthetic-data generator are promised rather than available.
events.why_it_matters: For teams maintaining many small gradient-boosted models, Kumo Tabular is a credible candidate for cold-start and low-label baselines. Trial the Medium model on held-out tables and calibration, then compare end-to-end latency and GPU cost with tuned tree ensembles. Do not treat the four leaderboard wins as independent confirmation: they are vendor-run, and performance can degrade outside the training ranges or under context/query distribution shift.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布开放权重表格基础模型 Kumo Tabular。它把带标签的行当作上下文，用一次前向计算完成分类或回归，无需针对任务训练或做特征工程。三种模型规模从 28M 到 215M 参数，全部用合成表格预训练。NVIDIA 报告它在 TabArena、BeyondArena、TALENT 与 ScoringBench 的综合排名均为第一。权重免申请并使用 OpenMDW-1.1，推理代码为 Apache-2.0；训练配方与合成数据生成器则仍停留在“即将发布”。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released Kumo Tabular, an open-weight tabular foundation model that predicts classification or regression targets from labeled rows in one forward pass without task-specific training or feature engineering. Three models span 28M to 215M parameters and were pretrained entirely on synthetic tables. NVIDIA reports first-place aggregate results on TabArena, BeyondArena, TALENT and ScoringBench. The weights are ungated under OpenMDW-1.1 and inference code is Apache-2.0, but the training recipe and synthetic-data generator are promised rather than available.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对维护大量小型梯度提升树模型的团队来说，Kumo Tabular 值得作为冷启动和少标签基线。可以先用 Medium 版本在留出表格上验证准确率与校准，再把端到端延迟和 GPU 成本与调优后的树模型比较。不要把四个 leaderboard 第一当成独立验证：这些都是厂商运行，超出训练范围或 context/query 分布变化时性能可能下降。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams maintaining many small gradient-boosted models, Kumo Tabular is a credible candidate for cold-start and low-label baselines. Trial the Medium model on held-out tables and calibration, then compare end-to-end latency and GPU cost with tuned tree ensembles. Do not treat the four leaderboard wins as independent confirmation: they are vendor-run, and performance can degrade outside the training ranges or under context/query distribution shift.

events.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Sol near Astra capability at lower cost
events.title_zh: OpenAI 发布低成本 GPT-6.1 Sol
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 已在 API、ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 提供 GPT-6.1 Sol，标准 token 价格低于 Astra。API 现将 Ultrafast 处理通过 service_tier: ultrafast 向所有用户开放，并提供独立限额、全球处理及美国或欧盟数据驻留。
events.summary_en: OpenAI offers GPT-6.1 Sol in the API, ChatGPT Work and Codex at a lower standard token price than Astra. The API now makes Ultrafast processing generally available through service_tier: ultrafast, with separate limits, global processing and US or EU data residency.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对延迟敏感的 agent 来说，Ultrafast 已从有限预览变成可用于生产路由的选项。切换默认档位前，应在数据驻留约束下测端到端任务延迟和完成任务成本。
events.why_it_matters_en: For latency-sensitive agents, Ultrafast is now a production-available routing choice rather than a limited preview. Measure end-to-end task latency and completed-task cost under your residency constraints before changing the default tier.

technical_details.availability: OpenAI API, ChatGPT Work and Codex; not Chat at launch
technical_details.context_pricing_threshold: standard prices shown for prompts up to 272K input tokens
technical_details.vendor_results: matches Astra on DeepSWE v1.1 at about one-fifth cost; within 2.1 points on OSWorld 2.0 at about one-seventh task cost
technical_details.safety: Critical cybersecurity and High biological/chemical capability under OpenAI Preparedness Framework
technical_details.ultrafast_2026_10_08: Generally available to all API users with service_tier: ultrafast; separate rate limits; global processing and US/EU data residency options.

technical_details_zh.厂商结果: DeepSWE v1.1 以约五分之一成本接近 Astra；OSWorld 2.0 相差 2.1 点，单任务成本约七分之一
technical_details_zh.安全分级: OpenAI Preparedness Framework 下网络安全为 Critical、生物化学为 High
technical_details_zh.Ultrafast_2026_10_08: 所有 API 用户可通过 service_tier: ultrafast 使用；独立限额；支持全球处理和美国/欧盟数据驻留。

events.next_action_zh: 用真实 agent 轨迹比较 standard 与 ultrafast 的端到端延迟、成功率、限额和单任务成本。
events.next_action_en: Compare standard and ultrafast on real agent traces for end-to-end latency, success, limits and cost per completed task.

events.why_it_matters: For latency-sensitive agents, Ultrafast is now a production-available routing choice rather than a limited preview. Measure end-to-end task latency and completed-task cost under your residency constraints before changing the default tier.

evidence.claim_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Sol，并已在 API、ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 提供。标准价为每百万输入 token 2 美元、缓存输入 0.10 美元、输出 10 美元。厂商测试称它在 coding、computer use 与专业任务上接近 GPT-6 Astra，但价格约为五分之一。Responses API 另提供 beta 多 agent 委派。
evidence.claim_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol in the API, ChatGPT Work and Codex. Standard prices are $2 per million input tokens, $0.10 cached input and $10 output. OpenAI reports near-GPT-6 Astra capability on coding, computer use and professional work at about one-fifth of Astra token prices. The Responses API also exposes beta multi-agent delegation.

evidence.claim_zh: OpenAI API changelog 确认 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast 已向所有 API 用户开放。
evidence.claim_en: The OpenAI API changelog confirms GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast is available to all API users.

events.title: OpenAI launches Dots as always-on cloud agents
events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出持续运行的云端 agent Dots
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Dots。每个 Dot 都有独立云端电脑，可连接应用，并在多次对话之间持续工作。产品由 GPT-6 Astra 驱动，用户可以设定自主范围并复核结果。首批面向部分 Pro 与 Business Premium 用户，Enterprise 需管理员开启 beta；一个月后的使用价格尚未公布。
events.summary_en: OpenAI launched Dots, always-on agents with individual cloud computers that can connect apps and continue work between conversations. Dots use GPT-6 Astra while users define autonomy and review results. Rollout is limited to eligible Pro and Business Premium users, with an administrator-enabled Enterprise beta; usage terms after the first free month are not published.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对设计长期运行 agent 的团队来说，Dots 把持续计算、应用连接和人工复核做成产品形态。但访问范围、后续计费和企业控制仍在变化，暂时只应观察真实任务完成率、撤权和审计能力。
events.why_it_matters_en: For long-running agent teams, Dots productize persistent compute, app connections and human review. Access, later pricing and enterprise controls are still moving, so watch real task completion, revocation and audit behavior before investing.
